# E0413: a lacuna on a mapping inside each

A lacuna on a mapping inside an each body would have to aggregate over the
list's elements. That is not supported yet; only a DroppedField lacuna on a
drop inside the body is, refining the drop's own.

## Example

`ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	items: [...{
		title?: string
	}]
}
```

`ship/1.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	items: [...{
		name: string
	}]
}

ForwardLens: {
	v0_0: _
	v1_0: {
		items: each(v0_0.items, {
			name: orelse(item.title, "untitled")
		})
	}
	lacunas: {
		items: {
			name: [{
				type:    Placeholder
				message: "the item had no title"
			}]
		}
	}
}

BackwardLens: {
	v1_0: _
	v0_0: {
		items: each(v1_0.items, {
			title: item.name
		})
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0413]: lacunas.items.name: a lacuna on a mapping inside each is not supported yet; a DroppedField lacuna on a drop refines the drop's
  --> 1.0.thema:16:11
   |
16 |             name: [{
   |                    ^
   |
```
